### Daily in Your Presence - April 22
Author: Rebecca Barlow Jordan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/dailypresence/daily-in-your-presence-april-22-1391514.html
Passage: Ruth 4:14
Points:
- Even when earthly friends or family depart, God remains steadfastly present with His children.
- Believers are deeply treasured by God, who purchased and redeemed them with His own life.
- Just as Boaz served as a kinsman-redeemer, the Lord steps in to meet our greatest spiritual needs and welcome us home.

### Glory in the Ordinary - Truth For Life - November 4
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-november-4-2024.html
Passage: Ruth 4:14-16
Points:
- Naomi returned to Bethlehem empty and grieving, but God restored her joy and hope through Ruth's child.
- God worked through two vulnerable widows to preserve the family line that led to King David and Jesus Christ.
- Jesus entered the world in ordinary circumstances and achieved redemption through a lowly cross rather than an earthly throne.
- The Lord accomplishes His grand redemptive plans through regular people doing everyday tasks in quiet faithfulness.
- Simple acts of kindness, love, and integrity have a far greater and longer-lasting impact than worldly achievements.
